title: Институционалниот протокол и дипломатската симболика: од СФРЈ до постмодерната македонска дипломатска практика
descriptive_english_title: Institutional Protocol and Diplomatic Symbolism: From SFRY to Postmodern Macedonian Diplomatic Practice
author: Sande Smiljanov
publisher: Ministry of Interior of the Republic of North Macedonia
wpa_paraphrase: Comparative study of the institutional and symbolic continuity of Macedonian diplomatic protocol across the Yugoslav period, independence and international-recognition period, and the 2000-2026 postmodern diplomatic period. The paper introduces the Protocol Thread as an analytical method for tracing credentials, flag symbolism, representation formulae and reception ceremony across those eras.
